SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.status evidenceStatus, s.source_code sourceCode,s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri, d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.content content, cu.content_hash contentHash FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.content_unit_id=cu.id AND e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND cu.id=#{contentUnitId} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.location_json locationJson,e.status evidenceStatus, s.source_code sourceCode,s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri, d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.content content, cu.content_hash contentHash FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND e.evidence_code=#{evidenceCode} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,s.name sourceName,e.location_json locationJson, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id WHERE e.id IN (SELECT evidence_id FROM t_claim_evidence WHERE claim_code=#{objectCode}) AND #{objectType}='CLAIM' UNION ALL SELECT e.evidence_code,e.quote_text,e.authority_score,e.freshness_score,s.name,e.location_json, cu.unit_code,cu.heading_path,cu.page_no,d.document_code,d.title FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id WHERE e.id IN (SELECT evidence_id FROM t_knowledge_evidence WHERE knowledge_code=#{objectCode}) AND #{objectType}='CARD' LIMIT 8

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.content_hash evidenceHash,cu.id contentUnitId,cu.unit_code unitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.chunk_type chunkType,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.page_end pageEnd,cu.char_start charStart,cu.char_end charEnd,cu.revision chunkRevision,cu.status chunkStatus,LEFT(cu.content,240) excerpt,d.id documentId,d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.status documentStatus,s.id sourceId,s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType,sv.version_no sourceVersion,s.authority_score authorityScore FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND e.object_type=#{objectType} AND e.object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY e.id

SELECT evidenceCode,evidenceHash FROM ( (SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,COALESCE(cu.content_hash,'') evidenceHash FROM t_knowledge_evidence k JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=k.evidence_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE k.knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND #{objectType}='CARD' ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,COALESCE(cu.content_hash,'') evidenceHash FROM t_claim_evidence c JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=c.evidence_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE c.claim_code=#{objectCode} AND #{objectType}='CLAIM' ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) ) x LIMIT 1
